newsitem.title: USA: U.S. blue chips, technology stocks roar higher.
newsitem.headline: U.S. blue chips, technology stocks roar higher.

text.p: U.S. blue chip stocks and the Nasdaq composite index were up strongly in afternoon trade Thursday, powered by a rally in the technology sector and optimism about U.S. emplpoyment data due tomorrow.
The Dow was up about 77 points at 7347. A quick move higher late in the morning prompted the New York Stock Exchange to set curbs on index-arbitrage trading.
The Nasdaq composite was up 13 points, or 0.97 percent, at 1393, boosted by rebounding technology stocks.

"The market is feeling pretty confident about tomorrow's employment numbers," said Alice Hook, first vice president and trader at McDonald & Co. "A lot of large-cap stocks have now had a tremendous run and we could see some profit-taking, but the money seems to be going into other issues."
U.S. non-farm payrolls are expected to show a rise of 219,000 for May, compared with a gain of 142,000 in April. The jobless rate is seen rising to five percent from 4.9 percent.
The benchmark 30-year Treasury bond was off 1/32 to yield 6.89 percent.
